name: Oshawa Favourites 2020

venue.name: General W. Sikorski Polish Veterans' Association Hall
venue.address: 1551 Stevenson Rd N, Oshawa, ON L1H 7K4

information: # This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Competitors get to choose which events to compete in (restrictions apply)! This will be a great opportunity to qualify for WCA North American Championship 2020. **You may choose at most four events. Registrations with more than four events will not be accepted.** Once your registration has been accepted, you will no longer be able to change your events by yourself. If you would like to change them, send the organization team an email and we will change your events for you as long as you inform us before online registration closes. Note: The schedule and additional rounds may change subject to final registration numbers.
